responsibility: This file implements the RTL mode-switching optimization pass for targets that require explicit processor mode changes around certain instructions. It scans insns to identify per-entity mode requirements, models mode-setting placement as a lazy code motion problem using lcm.cc bitmaps, computes transparent/anticipatable/computing sets, inserts targetm.mode_switching.emit sequences on edges or within blocks, and updates CFG and dataflow as needed. It is the generic scheduler-independent framework that minimizes explicit CPU mode changes according to target-provided mode-switching hooks.
